answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. The way a lantern roots the soil, a saffron returns each spring, and a raven reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
